node-library-storage.title: Photo Records and Media Storage
node-library-storage.description: Provides shared Room/SQLite persistence and media-storage operations. PhotoDatabase.kt defines photo and AI handoff records; LibraryDatabase.kt defines albums, memberships, edit drafts, people, faces, and scan records with query and mutation DAOs. LibraryFollowupDatabase.kt adds MediaStore references, scan tracking, manual backup authorizations with captured destinations and metadata receipts, person aliases, photo-person labels and origins, and a durable people indexing queue. Triggers enqueue indexing when imported metadata or source binding changes and remove associated label, queue, and device-reference rows when photos are deleted. LibraryPresenceDao derives a boolean Drive-presence result from cloud records or completed backup receipts with identity and trash checks. OfflineStorageRepository scans in batches of 120 and delegates eligible app-owned downloaded-copy removal to MediaCache, retaining ineligible items and recording access or verification failures. Versioned migrations evolve this shared state.
acceptanceCriteria: A device_media.photoId produced by reconciliation resolves through database.photos().find.
